## Goal
- Complete the "FINAL IVX ENTERPRISE STABILITY, TRAFFIC, TRANSACTION, AND CONNECTIVITY AUDIT" — 18-phase mandate: fix portfolio crash (totalDeposited/totalBalance undefined), reels instability, chat timeout, audit financial data integrity, transaction safety, idempotency, API reliability, auth, connected services, observability, then commit, deploy, build APK, verify, and deliver honest evidence in the required format.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications, no "no code change required" when a fix is required
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files >~30KB MUST use gzip-base64; Python `gzip.compress(raw, 9)`; omit `contentEncoding` for small files
- Render deploy API: same action endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; length ~1620)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Watchman refuses to start in low-priority sandbox — must exclude from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` dir with shim script that exits 1
- `bun test backend/` = 1521 tests across 111 files (~2.7s); `bun x tsc --noEmit` in expo/ for full typecheck (takes ~60-90s, run with nohup in background)
- Gradle builds exceed 60s — must run with `nohup env PATH=/tmp/nowatch:$PATH ./gradlew assembleRelease --build-cache --stacktrace > /tmp/gradle-build.log 2>&1 &` from `expo/android/` (NOT `expo/`) then poll PID + log tail + APK mtime/size
- APK presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` returns `uploadUrl` (900s expiry); PUT raw bytes with `Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive`; S3 ETag matches local md5 when successful
- `buildOwnerAIResponsePayloadInner` constructs response by explicitly listing each field from `internalMetadata` — MUST add new fields to this explicit list or they will be constructed but silently dropped

## Progress
### Done
- **APK v1.4.10(42) through v1.4.15(47) — ALL BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE-VERIFIED** (prior history)

- **FINAL IVX IA CHAT EXECUTION MODE — IMPLEMENTED + TESTED + COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + APK v1.4.14(46)**: 11 files, 26 backend tests, execution-mode classifier (10 categories), 9-field status payload, live-polling hook, execution console bubble UI. GitHub HEAD `f374b2bf`. (See prior history.)

- **CHAT BOUNDED-LOAD FIX 2026-07-19 — v1.4.15(47) COMMITTED + APK LIVE-VERIFIED**:
  - Root cause: `ivxChatService.ts:1186` — unbounded `.order('created_at', { ascending: true })` with NO LIMIT on months-old conversations
  - Fix: bounded DB query to newest 120 (descending then reversed) + display cap to newest 160
  - 6 files committed → GitHub HEAD `d7d7fa018afa90dfbfac57aab3241ca0d22f24fc`
  - APK v1.4.15(47): 84,550,192 bytes, md5 `2c8b23c9b700490584f56d099b734dc7`, live at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.15.apk

- **ENTERPRISE STABILITY PORTFOLIO PROVIDER FIX 2026-07-19 — v1.4.16(48) COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + APK LIVE-VERIFIED**:
  - **Root cause proven from code**: `EarnProvider` and `WalletProvider` were **NEVER mounted** in root `expo/app/_layout.tsx` (only I18n, Auth, Analytics, IPX, Email were mounted). `@nkzw/create-context-hook`'s `useEarn()`/`useWallet()` return `undefined` when called outside their provider. Direct destructuring in `wallet.tsx:57` (`const { totalBalance: earnBalance, apyRate } = useEarn()`) and `ipx-earn.tsx:40` (`const { totalDeposited, totalBalance, ... } = useEarn()`) threw exactly "Cannot read property 'totalBalance'/'totalDeposited' of undefined" — matching owner's reported errors. `portfolio.tsx:341` used optional chaining so it survived but silently showed $0.
  - **Fix (3 files changed + 2 version bumps = 5 files)**:
    1. `expo/app/_layout.tsx` — added `WalletProvider` + `EarnProvider` imports and mounted them inside `IPXProvider` with `ProviderBoundary` wrappers (Wallet > Earn > Email nesting)
    2. `expo/app/wallet.tsx:57` — changed direct destructure to safe access: `const earnCtx = useEarn() ?? null; const earnBalance = earnCtx?.totalBalance ?? 0; const apyRate = earnCtx?.apyRate ?? 0.10;`
    3. `expo/app/ipx-earn.tsx:38-54` — changed full destructure to safe property access with fallbacks for all 14 fields (totalDeposited, totalEarnings, totalBalance, projectedMonthly, projectedYearly, apyRate, currentTier, nextTier, currentQuarterProfit, quarterProgress, allTiers, payouts, deposit, withdraw)
    4. `expo/app.config.ts` — version 1.4.15→1.4.16, versionCode 47→48, buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_19_BUILD_48_ENTERPRISE_STABILITY_PORTFOLIO_PROVIDER_FIX`
    5. `expo/android/app/build.gradle` — versionCode 47→48, versionName 1.4.15→1.4.16
  - **QA**: `bun x tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `bun test backend/` 1521 pass / 0 fail (5593 expects)
  - **5 files committed** via owner-gated GitHub API (5/5 ok=True) → GitHub HEAD `3ac0c96312b51ef8068c1c6b9cae8b46cff4ca43` (msg: "v1.4.16(48) version bump")
  - **Render deploy triggered** (ok=True)
  - **APK v1.4.16(48) BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE-VERIFIED**: 84,552,128 bytes, md5 `f44f3c2dd20ee83909f0fa17855b843b`, sha256 `249a2bf567e8c3f9ac7772f682dfde0060feb532c325e423ac663d4fb57d4c97`, live at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.16.apk HTTP 200, content-length 84552128, S3 ETag `"f44f3c2dd20ee83909f0fa17855b843b"` == local md5 ✓

- **PHASE 7 (chat timeout) — VERIFIED LIVE**: POST /api/ivx/owner-ai with `{"message":"hello enterprise audit test"}` returned 200/0.28s with valid IVX IA response (no 90s timeout — execution-mode 202 path from prior cycle works)

- **PHASE 8 (reels) — CODE AUDITED**: Reels lifecycle already solid — 1 active player, max 3 mounted (active ± 1), background/focus/network pause, unmount cleanup via `unloadAsync`, 80% viewability threshold, pagination dedup by ID, `AppState` subscription properly removed in `useAppForeground.ts:28`. `SafeVideo.tsx` disables poster on Android, falls back from HLS to MP4, MAX_RETRIES=2. 60-min on-device test is owner-controlled (requires physical device).

- **PHASE 9+12+13 (API reliability + auth + connected services) — LIVE PROBES RUN**:
  - All 7 health endpoints return 200: `/health`, `/health/live`, `/health/ready`, `/health/ai`, `/health/database`, `/health/queue`, `/health/provider`
  - Auth: no-token POST to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` → 401 "IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer token." ✓
  - Auth: wrong-email login → 403 ✓
  - Connected services: GitHub API 200, S3 APK 200, Supabase real-data 200

### In Progress
- **18-phase enterprise audit delivery**: Phases 1-3, 7-9, 12-13 completed; remaining phases (2 dependency map, 4 financial data integrity, 5 transaction safety, 6 idempotency, 10 traffic load testing, 11 database audit, 14 observability, 15 release safety, 16 automated regression, 17 deployment verification, 18 evidence delivery) need to be addressed or honestly marked as owner-blocked/infrastructure-limited
- **3-way SHA parity for portfolio fix**: GitHub HEAD is `3ac0c963` but runtime /health was last checked showing `1d6f75d4` (from prior session); Render deploy was triggered but runtime commit not yet re-verified post-deploy

### Blocked
- Traffic load testing (Phase 10): requires load testing infrastructure not available in sandbox
- 60-min on-device Reels test (Phase 8): requires physical Android device — owner-controlled
- iOS build/verify (Phase 17): requires Apple credentials — owner-controlled
- Database enterprise audit (Phase 11): requires Supabase admin access for index/RLS/migration inspection
- Runtime SHA parity verification: needs another /health poll after Render deploy completes

## Key Decisions
- Portfolio crash fix: mounted providers in root layout (canonical fix) + safe destructuring with fallbacks (defense in depth) — NOT just optional chaining as owner explicitly required
- Reels code was already well-architected for long-session stability — no code change needed; 60-min test is owner-controlled
- Chat timeout was already fixed in prior cycle (execution-mode 202 path) — verified live at 0.28s response
- Auth finding initially appeared as a bug (no-token returned 200) but was a probe artifact — full body probe confirmed 401 with correct error message
- Honest about infrastructure limitations: will NOT fabricate load test results, on-device Reels test results, or iOS verification

## Next Steps
- Poll runtime /health to verify Render deploy completed for `3ac0c963`
- Deliver honest FINAL EVIDENCE in the owner's required 18-phase format (OVERALL STATUS, PORTFOLIO, REELS, CHAT, TRANSACTIONS, TRAFFIC, PRODUCTION, OPEN BLOCKERS)
- Mark infrastructure-limited phases honestly as BLOCKED/owner-controlled
- Update plan_md with enterprise stability completion entry

## Critical Context

- Portfolio crash root cause: `EarnProvider`/`WalletProvider` never mounted in root `_layout.tsx` → `useEarn()`/`useWallet()` return `undefined` → direct destructure throws
- Reels lifecycle: already solid (1 active player, max 3 mounted, background/focus/network pause, cleanup on unmount, AppState subscription removed)
- Chat async: already fixed (200/0.28s live response, no 90s timeout)
- Auth: properly gated (401 on missing token, 403 on wrong email)

- `expo/package.json` remains at 1.4.8 (system blocks direct edits); version bumped in `app.config.ts` and `android/app/build.gradle`
